words.run: one request, carried from your words to a commit
words.stage: one step of a run: Intent, Plan, Build, Review, Check
words.intent: what will be true when the run is done, from your request and your answers
words.criterion: one line of the intent that a test or a command can prove
words.plan: the tasks and the files that will change
words.task: one small change with its own test, written first
words.gate: the question where you decide; its header is Temper gate
words.check: something the CLI runs and judges: your suite, coverage, the acceptance tests
words.finding: something Review found, with a level from low to critical
words.repair: one counted fix a rule makes after a failed check
words.override: you pass a failed check, with a reason that is kept
words.loop back: the run goes to an earlier stage and does it again

retired.preflight: your commands run once on the current code
retired.hand back: the run goes on in the conversation
